Name: Stardew Valley Reimagined 2
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS]stardew valley reimagined ended up with a lot of bugs when 1.4 came out, and because it moved buildings and added new decorations, it changed a lot of npc pathing and events and required patches to be compatible with other mods — so i made another one!! this mod is a whole new version that hopefully doesn't affect anything besides the look of the game and won't cause any issues with mod compatibility and new content. it was also designed to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]my new recolour[/url] in particular — but it works with almost all major recolours (and just the vanilla game of course)

if you enjoy my mods, i have a [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/DaisyNiko]buy me a coffee page[/url] where you can leave a tip if you can and want to. x


[img]https://i.imgur.com/zcLlejM.png[/img]

[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]every outdoor map has been overhauled to give the game a fresh new look [/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]more trees, more berry bushes, more foraging areas[/font]
[*]all grass is tillable and all trees are able to be cut down
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]the dwarf now has his own little bedroom!![/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]previously unused/empty areas are now accessible, e.g. the hills above the train station[/font]
[*]all maps are able to be turned on/off individually in the config file
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7Zq4lTW.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]﻿
[*]download this mod and extract to Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]run the game with smapi
[/list]
if using with an old save, you will need to reset the bushes, trees, and debris with console commands or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]ResetTerrainFeatures[/url]﻿ mod


[img]https://i.imgur.com/LbkKqe1.png[/img]﻿
